description: shadcn/ui for Thymeleaf, packaged as a Spring Boot starter: server-rendered sl:* components (buttons, forms, dialogs, menus, tables, application shell) with htmx and Alpine.js support.
rules: Shadleaf components are Thymeleaf tags with the sl: prefix (xmlns:sl="https://shadleaf.dev/sl"), rendered on the server; do not write React, JSX, Radix or asChild.
The complete examples and attribute tables are in the docs as Markdown: https://shadleaf.dev/current/llms.txt (each page also at <page>.md).
An attribute that is not a declared prop passes through to the HTML silently; use only the props in a component's attribute table, and th:<prop> for expressions.
Do not put Tailwind utility classes on components to change them; the library's stylesheet has none. Use props such as variant, size and border.
A link styled as a button is <sl:button as="a" th:href="@{/x}">; sl:button renders type="button", so the submit button needs type="submit".
In a form with th:object, put th:field on sl:field: its label, control and errors share it. Place sl:form-errors before the fields.
Dialogs and sheets need an id and open from any button with commandfor="<id>" command="show-modal"; there are no trigger or close parts.
Icons are <sl:icon name="..."> with Lucide names; an icon-only button (size icon, icon-sm, ...) needs an aria-label or rendering fails.
